analysis.reason: 직전 관망에서 매수로 전환. RSI가 과매도 구간을 탈출하며 40선을 회복했고, 5일 저가가 20일 저가보다 높아지며 Higher Low 패턴의 초입을 확인했다. MACD 히스토그램도 개선되는 흐름이다.
analysis.reasonEn: Transitioned from wait-and-see to buy. RSI broke out of oversold territory, recovering above 40, and the 5-day low is higher than the 20-day low, confirming the start of a Higher Low pattern. MACD histogram is also improving.
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly is neutral, but daily signal takes precedence

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price (KRW 99,900) vs SMA5/20/50 (KRW 92,216 / 125,363 / 167,798) — Entering short-term uptrend channel, below mid-term MAs.
· Position vs SMA100/200 (KRW 136,416 / 96,016) — Attempting recovery after falling below long-term MAs.
· 52-Week Position (32.9%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (38.5→40.3) — Exiting oversold, strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-3222.6614→-3039.7507) — Bearish convergence zone, improvement signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-Band KRW 125,363) — Trading near mid-band, 88.25% bandwidth suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (KRW 68,045) — Based on Pivot S1 (KRW 47,100) and 20-day low (KRW 65,665).
· Swing Resistance (KRW 115,010) — Near 5-day high (KRW 118,860) and Pivot PP (KRW 118,465).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low recovery start) — Uptrend reversal signal confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.98x) — Normal level, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation) — Buy entry upon confirmation of RSI exiting oversold and Higher Low pattern.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가가 20일 저가보다 높아지며 상승 추세 전환의 초기 신호인 Higher Low 패턴이 형성되기 시작했다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The 5-day low is higher than the 20-day low, initiating the formation of a Higher Low pattern, an early signal of an uptrend reversal.
keyPoints: RSI가 과매도 구간(30선)을 탈출하여 40선으로 회복하며 상승 모멘텀 강화
5일 저가가 20일 저가보다 높아지는 Higher Low 패턴 초입 확인
MACD 히스토그램이 개선되는 흐름을 보이며 약세 수렴 구간에서의 반등 가능성 시사
keyPointsEn: RSI breaks out of oversold territory (30s) and recovers to the 40s, strengthening upward momentum.
Confirmation of the initial stage of a Higher Low pattern, with the 5-day low exceeding the 20-day low.
MACD histogram shows an improving trend, suggesting potential for a rebound from the bearish convergence zone.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 30.8로 추세는 뚜렷하나, -DI(36.8)가 +DI(17.6)보다 높아 하락 압력이 여전히 강하다. 52주 저가 대비 높은 위치지만, 50% 되돌림 레벨(201,728원) 대비로는 여전히 낮은 수준이다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: ADX at 30.8 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (36.8) is higher than +DI (17.6), suggesting persistent downward pressure. While higher than the 52-week low, it remains significantly below the 50% retracement level (KRW 201,728).
analysis.continuity: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 판독이 이어지고 있다. 금일 RSI 과매도 탈출 및 Higher Low 패턴 초입 확인으로 매수 의견으로 전환한다.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 straight sessions. Today, the RSI breaking out of oversold and the initial Higher Low pattern confirmation have led to a shift to a buy recommendation.
